verdicts.reason: A and B are almost pixel-identical. B moves the NEW pill and the Try It button up a few pixels, which gives a slightly larger bottom margin but changes nothing important. Both share the same flaws: the bottle's cap nearly touches the top edge, and its cream circle bleeds off the top-left corner. The top-right is a large empty area, and the left-aligned headline sits against right-aligned buttons with no shared axis. The NEW badge is almost as big as the CTA, so the two compete as focal points.
